text:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we have a last-minute walk-in guest at 11:30. They forgot to preregister and want a quick tour. Can someone cover reception for a few minutes?
June: I can stand by reception 11:25-11:40. Also, do we have extra lanyards? The drawer next to the printer is usually full.
Marcel: Heads-up the lanyard box is low  only plain white left, and the branded ones are in the storage closet (keycard needed).
FrontDesk-Bot: Visitor check-in attempt failed: NO_PREREG at 11:10. Suggest manual badge.
Ravi (People Ops): Manual badge is fine. Do we have any temporary printed badges prepped?
June: I can write a quick paper badge if the printer acts up. Also, tiny seating poll: couch in lobby vs high-top near window for an informal chat?
Marcel: Couch for casual, high-top if they bring laptops. What are they doing?
Ravi (People Ops): Mostly casual tour, no laptops. Couch wins.
Courier (UPS): Delivery at 10:58  "Oversized crate - acoustic panels" left at loading dock.
Olga: I think that crate is for office A/V. I can fetch it and stash in the back corridor. Its tagged "handle horizontal".
June: Also, small note: we found a lonely cactus in the lobby plant pot that looks perfect for a welcome table. Is that allowed? :cactus:
Ravi (People Ops): Yes! Please move cactus to the couch table (fragile warning: hands only).
Marcel: Quick badge note  the badge printer threw `PAPER_JAM: tray-2` this morning but `badge-cli print --manual` works. If we need a physical lanyard, I can grab one from storage and leave key with reception.
FrontDesk-Bot: Temporary badge printed at 11:22 for "Guest: Patel"  status: CHECKED_IN.
June: Guest checked in, couch set with cactus and a small note "Welcome!". Opening thread for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Leave crate instructions for facilities. Closing thread.
